final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT e.ordersmark, o.timespan, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark COLLATE BINARY = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY e.ordersmark, o.timespan), step2 AS (SELECT timespan, AVG(avg_fillcount) AS overall_avg FROM step1 GROUP BY timespan), step3 AS (SELECT s.ordersmark, s.timespan, s.avg_fillcount, s.avg_fillcount - t.overall_avg AS difference FROM step1 AS s JOIN step2 AS t ON s.timespan COLLATE BINARY = t.timespan COLLATE BINARY WHERE s.avg_fillcount > t.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fillcount, difference, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fillcount DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank FROM step3) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fillcount, difference, rank FROM step4 WHERE rank <= 3
